title: DAB Solutions
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science

steps_raw.instruction: Scope and Applicability: 3, 3´ Diaminobenzidine (DAB) is a commonly used chromogen for histological staining. In the presence of peroxidase enzyme, DAB produces a brown precipitate that is insoluble in alcohol and xylene. Peroxidase catalyzes hydrogen peroxide oxidation of substrate DAB. This SOP provides instructions to prepare four different formulations of DAB. DAB for Immunohistochemical staining (IHC), DAB for Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) Staining, Nickel enhanced DAB for Biocytin staining, and DAB for Biocytin staining.
3, 3´ Diaminobenzidine (DAB) (Sigma D5637 or equivalent).
Tris Buffered Saline; TNT (SOP RP0009).
0.1M Tris-HCl (SOP RP0179).
30% Hydrogen peroxide; H2O2 (Calbiochem 386790 or equivalent).
Ammonium Nickel Sulfate Hexahydrate (Sigma A1827 or equivalent)
P1000 and P200 pipette tips.
50 ml sterile serological pipette.
Weigh paper or weighboat.
P1000 and P200 Pipettes.
Sterile polystyrene bottle (250 ml, 500 ml, 1 liter or 2 liter).
Graduated cylinder (500, 1000 or 2000 ml).
Magnetic stir bar remover.
Fume Hood. DAB is a suspected carcinogen and should be weighed and prepared under the fume hood.

Remove DAB from the -20ºC freezer and allow it reach room temperature for 15 minutes before weighing.

For each of the listed DAB formulations, the final DAB working solution is made by combining 0.5 mg/ml DAB and H2O2. The two components are made separately, then combined just before use. See specific instructions below for preparation details.
Methodology/Procedures:
Preparation of DAB for IHC
Prepare 1% H2O2 Solution:
Referring to Table 1, below, add the correct volume of MilliQ water and 30% H2O2 using appropriate pipets into a conical tube.
Table 1: 1% H2O2 for IHC Staining
Prepare 0.05% DAB working solution for IHC:
Referring to Table 2, add the correct volume of 1X TNT using a serological pipette or graduated cylinder to an appropriate container or conical tube.
Table 2. 0.05% DAB Solution for IHC (0.5 mg/ml)
In a fume hood, use a balance, a clean spatula and weigh paper or a weighboat, and weigh out the correct amount of DAB (referring to Table 2). Transfer to the container of 1X TNT.
Note: Be careful of losing DAB when transferring to a conical tube or bottle due to static electricity.
Vortex, or stir using a stir plate until thoroughly mixed and no visible particulates remain.
Add the appropriate volume of 1% H2O2 (refer to table 2). Do not add the 1% H2O2 to the DAB solution until ready to use
Manually mix by swirling/inverting bottle or conical tube.
Preparation of DAB for Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) Staining
Prepare 0.03% H2O2 Solution:
Referring to Table 3 below, add the correct volume of MilliQ water and 30% H2O2 using a serological pipette or P200 pipette to an appropriate container or conical tube.
Table 3: 0.03% H2O2 for AChE Staining
Prepare 0.05% DAB solution for AChE staining:
Referring to Table 4, add the correct volume of 0.1M Tris-HCl to an appropriate container using a serological pipette or graduated cylinder.
In the fume hood, use a balance, a clean spatula and weigh paper or a weighboat, and weigh out the correct amount of DAB (refer to Table 4) and transfer to the bottle containing 0.1M Tris-HCl.
Note: Be careful of losing DAB when transferring to a conical tube or bottle due to static electricity.
Table 4: 0.05% DAB(-) Solution for Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) Stain (0.5 mg/ml)
Vortex, or stir on a stir plate until thoroughly mixed and no visible particulates remain.
Aliquot into two containers which will be used for the DAB (- H2O2) and DAB (+ H2O2) solutions.
When ready to prepare DAB (+H2O2) solution, add the appropriate amount of 0.03% H2O2 to the bottle of DAB (refer to Table 5). Do not add the 0.03% H2O2 to the DAB solution until ready to use.
Table 5: 0.05% DAB(+) Working Solution for (AChE) Staining
Manually mix by swirling/inverting bottle or conical tube.
Preparation of Nickel Enhanced DAB for Biocytin Staining
Prepare 0.3% H2O2 Solution:
Referring to Table 6 below, add the correct volume of MilliQ water and 30% H2O2 using appropriate pipets into a conical tube.
Table 6: 0.3% H2O2 Solution for Biocytin Staining
Prepare 1% Nickel Ammonium Sulfate Solution:
Referring to Table 7 below, add the correct volume of MilliQ water using a serological pipet into a conical tube.
Use a balance, a clean spatula and weigh paper or a weighboat, and weigh out the correct amount of Nickel Ammonium Sulfate Hexahydrate and transfer to the conical tube of MilliQ H20.
Vortex, or stir on a stir plate until thoroughly mixed and no visible particulates remain.
Table 7: 1% Nickel Ammonium Sulfate Hexahydrate (NH4)2Ni(SO4)2 · 6 H20
Prepare Nickel Enhanced 0.05% DAB working solution for Biocytin Staining:
Referring to Table 8, add the correct volume of 1X PBS (-) using a serological pipette or graduated cylinder to an appropriate container or conical tube.
Table 8. 0.05% DAB Working Solution for Biocytin Staining (0.5 mg/ml)
In a fume hood, use a balance, a clean spatula and weigh paper or a weighboat, and weigh out the correct amount of DAB (refer to table 8). Transfer to the container of 1x PBS (-).
Note: Be careful of losing DAB when transferring to a conical tube or bottle due to static electricity.
Vortex, or stir using a stir plate until thoroughly mixed and no visible particulates remain.
Add the appropriate volume of 1% Nickel Ammonium Sulfate (refer to table 8).
Add the appropriate volume of 0.3% H2O2 (refer to table 8). Do not add the H2O2 to the DAB solution until ready to use
Manually mix by swirling/inverting bottle or conical tube.
Preparation of DAB for Biocytin Staining
Prepare 0.3% H2O2 Solution:
Referring to Table 6 below, add the correct volume of MilliQ water and 30% H2O2 using appropriate pipets into a conical tube.
Table 6: 0.3% H2O2 Solution for Biocytin Staining
Prepare 0.05% DAB working solution for Biocytin Staining:
Referring to Table 8, add the correct volume of 1X PBS (-) using a serological pipette or graduated cylinder to an appropriate container or conical tube.
Table 8. 0.05% DAB Working Solution for Biocytin Staining (0.5 mg/ml)
In a fume hood, use a balance, a clean spatula and weigh paper or a weighboat, and weigh out the correct amount of DAB (refer to table 8). Transfer to the container of 1x PBS (-).
Note: Be careful of losing DAB when transferring to a conical tube or bottle due to static electricity.
Vortex, or stir using a stir plate until thoroughly mixed and no visible particulates remain.
Add the appropriate volume of 0.3% H2O2 (refer to table 8). Do not add the H2O2 to the DAB solution until ready to use
Manually mix by swirling/inverting bottle or conical tube.
Retain used and left over DAB solution in appropriately labeled container for disposal by licensed waste hauler.
Technical Information:
DAB should be stored at -20ºC and allowed to come to room temperature prior to weighing.
DAB solution expires 2 hours from the time it is prepared.
Hydrogen Peroxide must be added to DAB immediately before use. They must be combined immediately before adding to the autostainer for AChE and immediately before being dispensed.
